We introduce a new Reference Image to Slide Generation task and a novel Slide Complexity Metric for evaluating slide complexity. Based on this metric, we build the Slide2Code benchmark with different levels of difficulty. We also propose SlideCoder enhanced by a Color Gradient-based Segmentation algorithm, a Layout-aware Prompt and a Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation for accurate slide generation.

To comprehensively assess generation quality, we adopt four metrics, using the notations defined in §3.1. (1) Global Visual Metrics, including CLIP and SSIM scores computed between the original image I 0 and the generated image I g ; (2) Local Structural Metrics, which compare the original and generated slide files F 0 and F g in terms of content similarity and position similarity, following ; (3) Execution, defined as the success rate of executing C g without errors; and (4) Overall Score, calculated as the average of all metric values across all samples, with failed executions assigned a score of zero.
